entries.finding: No green remote quality/security/candidate runs on the candidate SHA; same-SHA unproven.
entries.impact: Promotion blocked; remote assurance missing for the exact tree.
entries.mitigation: Push + tag/dispatch with token; candidate pipeline runs all gates remotely.

entries.finding: Remote quality E2E step fails in CI without accessible logs; local reproductions (Node 22/24, CI mode) pass 45/45.
entries.impact: Quality workflow red; root cause undiagnosed (environmental suspected).
entries.mitigation: E2E diagnostics hardened (§13); rerun on next push; escalate with CI log access.

entries.finding: Mutation assurance covers 6 critical scopes (1139 mutants); diagnostic machine and remaining use-cases unmutated.
entries.impact: Undetected logic gaps possible outside the measured scope.
entries.mitigation: Adjusted 98.84% on covered scope (G10 >= 95% PASS); expand by criticality next.

entries.finding: Files over 1000 lines remain (registries, repositories, web pages).
entries.impact: Larger blast radius on change; mitigated by budgets and ratchets.
entries.mitigation: Complexity budgets enforced; split only with proven gain.

entries.finding: Branch coverage margin thin above the 86% hardening target.
entries.impact: Future test changes could dip below target before the floor.
entries.mitigation: Floor gate at 85% plus hardening tests; monitor per run.
Axe clean; AT audit when users onboard.

entries.finding: P2-EDGE-TRUST (independent review v2): edge trustedProxies unwired; leftmost-XFF attacker-controlled if ever wired under appending proxy.
entries.impact: Future misconfiguration could over-trust or spoof client IP; currently fail-closed (spoof ignored).
entries.mitigation: Wire CVG_TRUSTED_PROXIES explicitly with strip-vs-append docs + appending-proxy spoof test before any prod topology.

entries.finding: P2-EDGE-OUTAGE (independent review v2): Postgres rate-limiter DB errors propagate uncaught at edge (500/hang) instead of explicit fail-closed 429.
entries.impact: Availability/observability only: outage denies, never allows; no bypass.
entries.mitigation: Wrap edge check in try/catch returning 429 retry-after:1 with metric; deferred pending live-PG failure verification — do not change blind.

entries.finding: P2-FORGERY-SCREEN (independent review v2): anti-forgery marker list narrow and trivially avoidable.
entries.impact: Negligible alone: screen is defense-in-depth; bypass yields no PASS without forging digests+remote.
entries.mitigation: Keep as tripwire; expand schema validation over marker hunt in future hardening.

entries.finding: P2-EVID-SELF (independent review v2): verifier never cross-checked manifest.artifacts[].sha256. REMEDIATED this round.
entries.impact: None remaining: manifest cross-check implemented in verify-triple-aaa plus self-test 'manifest hash mismatch'.
entries.mitigation: Implemented and verified: 25/25 verifier self-tests green.
